'product revenue is more than a third of the quarter's revenue' states a share that no calculator path supplies; the only field cited is trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin, and the share is not quoted from a filer paragraph.

The inputs settle it: 8k_2_02:79/8k_2_02:88 subtract purchases of property and equipment and then add real-estate purchases back. The 10-Q investing facts (0001262039-26-000021:f-378 to f-390), 8k_2_02:72 and mdna:182 carry no separate real-estate outflow. The productive-assets fact (f-755) is the PP&E-note real-estate acquisition (f-756/f-757). So the outlay sits inside the property-and-equipment line.
'doubled' / 'roughly doubled' sizes a commitment that, as the analyst concedes, no calculator field carries (terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations missing).
'doubled purchase commitments' is a magnitude that no calculator path supplies.
'Commitments that MD&A says roughly doubled': MD&A (mdna:168) prints the two amounts, not a multiple. The multiple is the analyst's, and no calculator path carries the commitments.

calibration.why: estimates_and_reserves says 'one adverse estimate signal', yet its own finding and anomaly list add the excess-purchase-commitment liability falling without cause. Six areas list anomalies under no verdict. The financial efficiency reading calls the articulation gaps 'small', while the accounting frame lists the inventory gap as an anomaly.
